SELECT c.COMPANY_CODE, s.CURRENT_PRICE, s.CURRENT_USER_COUNT, s.PLAN_CODE, s.SUBS_START, s.SUBS_END, s.SUB_CODE, s.SUBS_STATUS, st.CODE_NAME AS inactiveReasonName FROM TB_COMPANY_MASTER c JOIN TB_SUBSCRIBE s ON c.COMPANY_CODE = s.COMPANY_CODE JOIN TB_CM_CODE st ON st.CODE = s.INACTIVE_REASON WHERE SUBS_STATUS = 'INACTIVE' ORDER BY c.COMPANY_CODE
